business_summary: LANDNET Inc. engages in the real estate investment business in Japan and internationally. It is involved in buying and selling used apartments for investment; brokerage, rental, rental brokerage, and rental management; real estate consulting; holding real estate investment seminars; real estate rental business Renovation business and remodeling business. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
